description_en: Releases the public endpoints of a PolarDB cluster, including the primary endpoint, default cluster endpoint, and custom cluster endpoint
description_zh: 释放PolarDB集群的公网地址，包括主地址、默认集群地址和自定义的集群地址的公网连接地址
kebab_example: aliyun polardb delete-db-endpoint-address --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000 --net-type Public --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDBEndpointAddress

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters that belong to your account, such as the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the endpoint.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98205.html operation to query the endpoints of a specified PolarDB cluster
parameters.help_zh:
连接地址ID。

您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98205.html查询DBEndpointId
parameters.name: db_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The network type of the endpoint. Set the value to Public (public network)
parameters.help_zh:
<props="intl">连接地址的网络类型，仅支持Public（公网）类型。</props>
<props="china">连接地址的网络类型，取值范围如下：</props>
<props="china">- Public：公网。</props>
<props="china">- Inner：经典网络。</props>
parameters.name: net_type
